proposal.description: The S_RUN trip is masked on the cycle-boundary strobe clock, as if the run count were mid-update there, though the count is a register and is valid on that clock.
proposal.reason: In S_RUN, once fault_count_run is at or above trip_run, window_trip drops to 0 for one clock on every pwm_rise. If the run count first reaches trip_run and the next valley falls on the same clock that S_RUN is entered or held, the trip is delayed by one clock.
